issues.description: The exercise specification/UML defines `addGuestStudents(int)` as returning `void`, but the reference solution implements `addGuestStudents(int)` returning `boolean`. This signature mismatch makes the intended API unclear and can cause student implementations (following the UML) to fail against tests expecting the solution's signature (or vice versa).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution match the specification by changing the method signature to `public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents)` and removing boolean returns; alternatively, if success/failure reporting is intended, update the problem statement and UML to specify a `boolean` return type.
